title: Transport lab
blurb: Nearly fifty routes for getting DOM out of its canvas: snapshots, bitmaps, video frames, streams, WebRTC, codecs, WebGL. Each one is tested in your browser.
question: Which transports can carry drawn DOM to another context? About fifty are tested, with the reason for each failure.

cls.why: known: the list of sources grows one 24 px row at a time while the lab runs
